name: Unescoceratops
sum: Unescoceratops is a small leptoceratopsid from the Dinosaur Park Formation of Alberta, known from a single jaw.
wsnote: Estimated between one and two metres long and under 91 kg (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: TMP 95.12.6, a partial left dentary — Dinosaur Park Formation, Dinosaur Provincial Park, Alberta.
material: Holotype only; first thought to be Leptoceratops.
biology: Known from one jaw; no behavioural data.
author: Ryan et al. 2012

sources.text: Ryan, Michael J.; Evans, David C.; Currie, Philip J.; Brown, Caleb M.; Brinkman, Don 2012. New leptoceratopsids from the Upper Cretaceous of Alberta, Canada. Cretaceous Research 35: 69–80. doi:10.1016/j.cretres.2011.11.018
